title: Spiral Matrix
summary: Read every value of a rectangular grid in clockwise spiral order, starting from the top-left corner.

tests.explain: Go right along the top, down the right edge, left along the bottom, up the left edge, then the single middle cell.
In a 3 x 4 grid the last lap is a single row: 6, 7 are read once going right, not again going left.
In a 4 x 3 grid the last lap is a single column of two cells.

hints: Think of four walls: top, bottom, left and right. Each lap along the border moves one wall inward.
Walk the top row left to right, then top++; the right column downward, then right--; the bottom row right to left, then bottom--; the left column upward, then left++.
After the first two sides of a lap, check that top <= bottom and left <= right before walking the other two, or a single remaining row or column gets read twice.

complexity.time: O(rows * columns): each cell is visited once
